title: Labeling of an investigational new drug
text: The immediate package of an investigational new drug intended for human use shall bear a label with the statement “Caution: New Drug—Limited by Federal (or United States) law to investigational use.”

title: Labeling of an investigational new drug
text: The label or labeling of an investigational new drug shall not bear any statement that is false or misleading in any particular and shall not represent that the investigational new drug is safe or effective for the purposes for which it is being investigated.

title: Labeling of an investigational new drug
text: The appropriate FDA Center Director may grant certain exceptions or alternatives under the conditions specified in § 312.6(c).
topic: exceptions or alternatives to labeling requirements

text: The EU Clinical Trials Regulation includes labeling provisions in Articles 66–70, with detailed investigational medicinal product labeling requirements in Annex VI.
notes: Summary extracted from BDO article; verify against official consolidated Annex VI before treating as binding requirements. These are secondary-source notes, not verbatim EU legislation. Exact legally binding wording of each applicable Annex VI provision requires verification.

text:
Depending on the product and packaging configuration, Annex VI addresses:
- Sponsor, contract research organization, or investigator identification and contact details.
- Substance name and strength or potency.
- Pharmaceutical dosage form, route of administration, and quantity.
- Batch or code number.
- Clinical trial reference code.
- Subject identification, treatment, or visit number.
- Directions for use.
- Clinical-trial-use wording.
- Storage conditions.
- Period of use, such as expiry or retest date.
- Child-safety wording, subject to applicable exceptions.
notes: Secondary-source summary, not verbatim EU legislation; exact legally binding wording of each applicable Annex VI provision requires verification against the official consolidated text. Country-specific language requirements and product-specific exceptions also require verification.

text: Applicability varies across Annex VI categories, including general investigational medicinal products, limited immediate-package labeling, unauthorized auxiliary medicinal products, and authorized investigational medicinal products. Do not assume every listed field is mandatory for every product.

text: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/2239 amended Annex VI regarding the period of use on immediate packaging. Under specified conditions and with appropriate justification, the period of use may be omitted from immediate packaging where quality or safety risks associated with relabeling arise. Packaging configuration and applicable conditions must be verified against the official amended text.

title: Mandatory Labeling Requirements
text:
The clinical trial sponsor shall indicate the following information in Japanese on the container or packaging of an investigational drug.
However, when conducting an expanded access clinical trial, only the information specified in Items (i) and (ii) shall be required.
(i) A statement indicating that the drug is intended for clinical trial use.
(ii) The name and address of the clinical trial sponsor. If the sponsor does not have an address in Japan, the label shall indicate the sponsor's name, the country in which the sponsor is located, and the name and address of the in-country clinical trial representative in Japan.
(iii) The chemical name or identification code of the investigational drug.
(iv) The manufacturing number or manufacturing identification code.
(v) The storage conditions, validity period, and other relevant information, where such conditions or periods need to be established.
notes: Working English translation of Japanese legislation; translation and effective date require verification against the official Japanese text. Version date is as claimed by the supplied document.

title: Information Prohibited from Labeling
text:
The clinical trial sponsor shall not include the following information in documents accompanying the investigational drug, on the investigational drug itself, or on its container or packaging, including inner packaging:
(i) The proposed commercial name of the drug.
(ii) The proposed indications or therapeutic effects.
(iii) The proposed dosage and administration.
Exception: These restrictions shall not apply when conducting a clinical trial using investigational drugs for which trial participants, principal investigators and other investigators, or clinical trial collaborators are not prevented from identifying the investigational drug and comparator drug, or when conducting an expanded access clinical trial.
notes: Working English translation of Japanese legislation; translation and effective date require verification against the official Japanese text.

title: Emergency Identification in Blinded Clinical Trials
text: When an investigational drug has been supplied to a clinical trial institution under conditions in which trial participants, investigators, and clinical trial collaborators cannot distinguish the investigational drug from the comparator drug, the sponsor shall establish necessary measures to ensure that investigators can immediately identify the investigational drug and comparator drug in an emergency.
notes: Working English translation of Japanese legislation; translation and effective date require verification against the official Japanese text.

title: Packaging During Transportation and Storage
text: The clinical trial sponsor shall package investigational drugs appropriately before supplying them to clinical trial institutions in order to prevent contamination or deterioration during transportation and storage.
notes: Working English translation of Japanese legislation; translation and effective date require verification against the official Japanese text.

title: Supply of Investigational Drugs
text: In the circumstances described in the proviso to Paragraph 1, the clinical trial sponsor shall ensure that the information specified in Article 16, Paragraph 1, Items (i) and (ii), is indicated in Japanese on the container or packaging of the investigational drug at a location employing appropriate manufacturing management and quality control methods.
